sections.heading: The 360° Branded Cylinder That Owns the Shelf
sections.text: Round Paper Tube Packaging The 360° Branded Cylinder That Owns the Shelf A cylinder tube box wraps your product in a continuous, seam-aware 360° printed surface — no flat front, no dead panels. That uninterrupted canvas is why premium candle, tea, coffee, spirits and skincare brands choose round tube packaging to stand apart from the sea of square cartons. Our tubes are spiral-wound from rigid paperboard (not flimsy single-ply card), so the wall holds its shape, resists denting in transit, and gives a reassuring weight in hand. Ends are configured to your product: snug paperboard lids, brushed-metal caps, clear PET windows, or shoulder-and-neck telescoping closures. Every tube is produced in-house from board winding to wrap lamination, so registration stays crisp around the full circumference and the top/bottom seams sit flush. Add gold foil, soft-touch matte, embossed logos or a tear-strip opening to finish the unboxing.

sections.text: Target Industries Built for Round-Product Categories Cylinder tubes suit any product that benefits from a tall, round, premium presentation: Candles & Home Fragrance Snug tubes with foam or pulp base that cradle glass candle jars and reed-diffuser sets safely in transit. sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions What is a cylinder tube box made of? Our cylinder tubes are spiral-wound from rigid paperboard (1.2mm–2.5mm wall), then wrapped with your printed art paper or kraft. This makes a sturdy, dent-resistant round box — far stronger than single-ply card tubes — with paperboard, metal, wood or window end caps. What is the minimum order quantity for custom tube packaging? Standard MOQ is 200 pcs for a custom diameter with full 360° wrap printing. Smaller pilot runs can be discussed for premium projects. Can tube boxes be food-grade for tea, coffee or supplements? Yes. We offer food-grade inner liners and aluminium-foil liners that preserve aroma and meet food-contact requirements for loose-leaf tea, coffee beans, bath salts and capsules. Do you offer eco-friendly / recyclable paper tubes? Yes. We produce plastic-free, mono-material paper tubes using FSC-certified board, paperboard ends and water-based coatings so the whole tube is recyclable. What end caps and openings are available? Paperboard push-fit lids, brushed-metal aluminium caps, wooden lids, clear PET windows, telescoping shoulder-neck closures, and easy-tear strips.
